title: Technology Sector Update for 01/23/2019: UTX,IBM,DOX

Technology stocks were little changed in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding 0.1% in value this afternoon, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling 0.8%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) United Technologies ( UTX ) was 5% higher after saying its Rockwell Collins acquisition helped boost its non-GAAP Q4 earnings during the final three months of 2018 compared with the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $1.95 per share, improving on $1.60 per share during the same quarter 12 months ago and topping the Street view by $0.42 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) International Business Machines ( IBM ) was 8% higher Wednesday after reporting better-than-expected Q4 financial results and issued above-consensus FY19 outlook. The company is projecting non-GAAP net income this year of at least $13.90 per share, exceeding the Capital IQ consensus by at least $0.09 per share.
(-) Amdox Ltd ( DOX ) was down about 12% after a short-seller issued a negative research report about the software services firm, writing the company's stock could drop between 25% to 50% over the intermediate term. Spruce Point Capital also said Amdox has been using acquisitions to give the appearance of revenue growth as well as relying on "accounting gimmicks" to distort its financial condition.
